name: Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; Print Buddy test fixture start: invented, not Bambu Lab or OrcaSlicer G-code
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
G28
G90
{if curr_bed_type=="Textured PEI Plate"}
M290 Z-0.05 ; fixture textured plate offset
{endif}
G1 X-40 Y10 F6000 ; park beside the bed
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
G1 X-40 Y-0.4 F3000
G1 E5 F300 ; prime off the bed
G1 X10 Y10 Z0.4 F6000
G92 E0
M400
machine_end_gcode:
; Print Buddy test fixture end: invented, not Bambu Lab or OrcaSlicer G-code
G91
G1 Z2 F600
G90
G1 X-40 Y200 F6000
M104 S0 ; hotend off
M140 S0 ; bed off
M106 S0
{if max_layer_z < 100}
G1 Z120 F600
{endif}
M84
